_comment: Editorial content for ALIFE. Every fact is attributable — see sourceNote. No image is attached. ALIFE is a life insurer and operates a Window Takaful operation; it is not a fund or a Modaraba.
description: Adamjee Life Assurance Company Limited is a life insurer backed by the Nishat Group, which the company describes as one of the leading and most diversified business groups in South East Asia. It writes individual life business — savings plans for education and wedding goals and term protection such as its salary protection plan — alongside bancassurance and corporate group life, credit life, provident fund and pay continuation covers. It also runs a Window Takaful operation for Shariah-compliant business.
headOffice: Adamjee House, I.I. Chundrigar Road, Karachi 74000, Pakistan
sourceNote: Written from: https://www.adamjeelife.com/en/about-us (Nishat Group backing, address and telephone), https://www.adamjeelife.com/en/about-us/management-and-bods (chief executive, board), https://www.adamjeelife.com/en/individual-life (individual life plans, Roshan Aaj Aur Kal, salary protection plan), https://www.adamjeelife.com/en/corporate (group life, group credit life, group provident fund, group pay continuation) (accessed 2026-10-17)

products.name: Individual life savings plans
products.summary: Savings plans for education and wedding goals, such as Roshan Aaj Aur Kal, with a choice of investment funds matched to risk appetite and religious beliefs.

products.name: Salary protection plan
products.summary: A term life product paying a selected percentage of monthly salary to beneficiaries on death or permanent total disability.

products.name: Group life assurance
products.summary: A single master policy for employees, renewable annually, with cover uniform or graded by designation, length of service or salary.

products.name: Group credit life assurance
products.summary: Credit life protection for borrowers on personal loans, credit cards and mortgages, repaying the outstanding balance on death or disability.

products.name: Group provident fund life assurance
products.summary: A group benefit that works alongside an employer's provident fund.

products.name: Window Takaful operations
products.summary: Shariah-compliant Takaful business written through the company's Window Takaful operation.
